tablero.title: How the campaign is going
tablero.description: Everything here comes from the campaign and from what has already happened: no made-up forecasts.

plazas.label: Seats
plazas.free: {n, plural, =0 {None left} one {# free} other {# free}}
plazas.inside: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody in yet} one {# clipper in} other {# clippers in}}
plazas.help: Seats are taken by accepted clippers, by those who already delivered and by those who finished. If someone runs out of time or withdraws, the seat comes back.

esperados.label: Clips you expect
esperados.review: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing to review} one {# delivered, unreviewed} other {# delivered, unreviewed}}
esperados.help: One clip for every accepted commitment still within its deadline. Anyone who runs out of time or withdraws stops counting.

comprometido.label: Budget committed
comprometido.exceeds: That is more than what is left: someone will earn less than the cap.
comprometido.help: What those clips would cost if every one of them hit the per-video cap ({cap}). It is the worst case, not a forecast.

dias.label: Campaign days
dias.help: What is left until the end date. A delivery deadline never goes past it.

ritmo.label: Pace needed
ritmo.clips: {n, plural, one {# clip at the cap uses it up} other {# clips at the cap use it up}}
ritmo.none: No budget left to hand out
ritmo.help: The budget left divided by the days left. If nobody delivers, nothing is spent.

solicitudes.title: Requests
solicitudes.description: Who wants in. Once you accept, the clipper has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to deliver their clip.

empty.title: No requests to decide
empty.description: When a clipper asks to join, you will see their profile here and decide.

closed.title: Signups closed
closed.description: Nobody new gets in. You finish with whoever is already inside.

noNuevos.title: This campaign no longer takes new people
noNuevos.description: You can still reject whatever is undecided; accepting is no longer possible.

solicitudes.full: No free seats left: accepting one more would go over the limit.

accepted.title: {name} is in
accepted.description: They have until {date} to deliver their clip.

dialog.title: Reject {name}
dialog.description: The reason is stored as a code and shown to them in their language. They can ask again if things change.
dialog.needReason: Pick a reason to be able to reject.

motivos.no-encaja-publico: Not a fit for the audience
motivos.no-encaja-tema: Not a fit for the topic

perfil.sinTemas: Has not said what they clip

historial.title: On Clipealo
historial.deEnviados: of {n, plural, one {# sent} other {# sent}}
historial.vacio: They have not sent any clips here yet: you are deciding without a track record.

perfil.frontera: This is everything a request shows: no email, no earnings, no list of the other campaigns they applied to.

cerrar.title: Closing the campaign
cerrar.description: Closing signups stops new people from joining and lets you finish with those already inside. Finishing is only possible with no work pending.
cerrar.closeSignupsHint: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody is waiting for a decision.} one {# undecided request will be rejected, with the reason “signups closed”.} other {# undecided requests will be rejected, with the reason “signups closed”.}}
cerrar.reopenHint: It takes requests again. The ones you rejected do not come back on their own.

closed.title: Signups closed
closed.description: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody new gets in; you carry on with whoever is inside.} one {Nobody new gets in and # request was rejected.} other {Nobody new gets in and # requests were rejected.}}

cerrar.blocked: {n, plural, one {There’s still {list}.} other {There are still {list}.}}

pendientes.sinRevisar: {n, plural, one {# clip to review} other {# clips to review}}
pendientes.aceptadas: {n, plural, one {# clipper with a deadline of {date}} other {# clippers with a deadline of {date}}}
pendientes.enDisputa: {n, plural, one {# unresolved dispute} other {# unresolved disputes}}

cerrar.ready: No work pending: you can finish whenever you want.

confirm.title: Finish “{title}”?
confirm.description: It stops taking clips and closes for everyone. This cannot be undone.

finished.title: Campaign finished
finished.description: Nobody is left with work to deliver.

dentro.descripcion: The live commitments on this campaign. While any is open, the campaign can’t be closed.
dentro.plazo: {n, plural, =0 {Last day to deliver} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
dentro.vencido: {n, plural, one {Overdue by # day} other {Overdue by # days}}
